pending_body: Your account has been created successfully. Your login access request is waiting for approval from an administrator or examiner.
pending_poll_note: This page checks for a decision every few seconds — you do not need to refresh. Once you are approved you will be taken straight through.
rejected_body: Your account exists, but a reviewer has not granted you access to the platform. You cannot open the dashboard or sit examinations until that decision is changed.
rejected_help: If you believe this is a mistake, contact your administrator or the examiner running your course. They can reopen your access from the login-request queue.
quote_1: Prepare with confidence. Perform with purpose.
quote_2: Preparation is the quiet work that makes the exam loud with answers.
quote_3: Steady hands, clear head — the paper is only what you have already practised.
quote_4: You are not being asked to be perfect. You are being asked to show what you know.
welcome_body: Your login access has been approved, so the platform is open to you. Your dashboard lists the examinations you have been assigned — each one shows its window, duration and what the proctoring will check before you begin.
welcome_point_1: Sit only the examinations assigned to you
welcome_point_2: Every paper is generated for you alone
welcome_point_3: Your camera and browser activity are monitored during a sitting
